name: database
description: Manage database: create/update/delete. `update` is how you expose an existing database on a public port (`is_public` + `public_port`) or change limits/credentials.

destination_uuid.description: Destination UUID. Required if the server has multiple destinations; find it with `list_destinations`. Credential fields must match the database engine (postgres_* on postgresql, and so on).

is_public.description: Expose on a public port. On update, true asks for confirmation first.

limits_memory.description: Update only, e.g. "512m". limits_* take effect after a `control` restart.

postgres_password.description: On update this rotates the live credential; every app using the old value breaks. Asks for confirmation first.
